categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the 'Private Broadcast' label, which is an explicit prior for P2P, and modifies transaction relay persistence in the broadcast manager over Tor/I2P.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent loss of unbroadcast transactions if the node restarts before private relay completes. As the author notes, currently 'a submitted transaction can be lost if the node restarts before it is privately broadcast,' undermining relay liveness and privacy feature reliability.
